transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.

transferFrom assumes msg.sender is the authorised market contract.

buyPack reads packSize to size the minted card list.
buyPack reads packPrice to compute the required payment.
buyPack passes totalCardCount to the dice oracle.
buyPack executes packPrice * _count without overflow protection.
buyPack increases the caller card balances.
buyPack appends PackBuy entries to packBuys.
buyPack invokes dice to draw random card ids.
dice calls maxDice to obtain randomness.
maxDice mutates the seed state variable.
maxDice mixes now (block.timestamp) into the randomness seed making it miner manipulable.
dice returns the generated card id back to buyPack.
dice supplies random card ids to getPack.
CopaCore.withdrawEthBalance performs owner.transfer of the full balance.
withdrawEthBalance sends funds to the owner state variable.
CopaMarket constructor stores the core contract address.
setCopaCoreAddress reassigns the core contract used for card custody.
setCut updates the cut used in sale computations.
setTradingFee updates the trade fee.
setSecureFees toggles fee forwarding behaviour.
sellCard conditionally forwards the fee based on secureFees.
buyCard conditionally forwards the fee based on secureFees.
tradeCards conditionally forwards the fee based on secureFees.
secureFees gates the owner.transfer fee payment.
secureFees gates the trading fee transfer inside tradeCards.
addToBuyList pushes a new Buy order.
addToBuyList performs lockedEth += _ethAmount with raw arithmetic.
addToBuyList increases the lockedEth escrow.
sellCard performs lockedEth -= _ethAmount without SafeMath.
sellCard computes (_ethAmount * _cut) / 10000 with raw arithmetic.
sellCard performs an external ETH transfer to the seller.
sellCard performs an external ETH transfer of the fee to the owner.
sellCard makes an external call into copaCore.transferFrom.
sellCard calls the core contract for card settlement.
sellCard reads cut to derive the market fee.
sellCard flips the Buy.open flag of the filled order.
sellCard releases the corresponding lockedEth escrow.
cancelBuy performs lockedEth -= _ethAmount without SafeMath.
cancelBuy performs an external ETH refund to the buyer.
cancelBuy decreases the lockedEth escrow.
cancelBuy sets the Buy.open flag to false.
addToSellList pushes a new Sell order.
addToSellList calls into copaCore.transferFrom to escrow cards.
buyCard updates the Sell order of the seller.
buyCard performs an external ETH transfer of the fee to the owner.
buyCard computes (_ethAmount * _cut) / 10000 with raw arithmetic.
buyCard reads cut to compute the seller proceeds.
buyCard calls CopaCore.transfer to deliver the cards to the buyer.
cancelSell closes the Sell order.
cancelSell calls CopaCore.transfer to return escrowed cards.
addToTradeList pushes a new Trade offer.

tradeCards reads and closes the Trade offer.
tradeCards performs an external ETH transfer of the trading fee to the owner.
tradeCards requires msg.value to cover tradingFee.
tradeCards calls CopaCore.transfer to hand over the offered cards.
tradeCards calls copaCore.transferFrom to pull the requested cards.
cancelTrade closes the Trade offer.
cancelTrade calls CopaCore.transfer to return escrowed offered cards.
CopaMarket.withdrawEthBalance performs owner.transfer of the full balance including lockedEth.
withdrawEthBalanceSave computes _ethBalance - lockedEth with raw subtraction.
withdrawEthBalanceSave reads lockedEth to keep escrow in the contract.
withdrawEthBalanceSave deducts lockedEth from the amount sent out.
